prompt: Implement a bounded least-recently-used cache and document the complexity of lookup and eviction.

public_tests.name: edge case
public_tests.description: Include at least one empty, invalid, boundary, duplicate, timeout, cancellation, or platform-specific case relevant to this exercise.

acceptance_criteria: The implementation meets the stated required behavior on representative input.
The implementation handles at least one relevant edge case explicitly.
The solution is readable, uses idiomatic Kotlin, and documents required runtime/dependencies.
The learner states the test or local command used to verify the result.
hints: List the inputs, expected outputs, and invalid/boundary cases before writing the implementation.
Break the task into small functions/types that directly support: generics, data structures, complexity.
Run a small test after each milestone and keep implementation dependencies outside the core domain logic where practical.

retry_policy.notes: Retry after reading feedback; server-supported grading checks only the configured text/token condition and is not a substitute for compiling/testing Kotlin code.
